title: Alt Text Check
summary: Checks each image's alt text before posting, so filenames, "image of" and empty alt text don't reach screen-reader users.
description: Checks each image's alt text for missing text, filenames (IMG_2041.jpg, PXL_…), "image of…" redundancy, caption copies and excess length, with per-image status, one-tap fixes, a decorative toggle and a reminder when the image has words. Post jumps to the first problem.
catches: Filenames, camera names and hashes used as alt text
Alt text that repeats the caption, or runs past the length limit
Screenshots and images with text whose alt text may not include that text
limits: It checks wording patterns, not whether the description is accurate
Whether an image contains text comes from your data (OCR or uploader); screenshots are assumed to
Posting with problems is still possible after the first press
a11y: Each alt field has a <label> and aria-describedby pointing at its hint; aria-invalid when there is a problem
Per-image hints and the summary are aria-live="polite"
Post moves focus to the first field with a problem
Status uses text and icons, not colour alone
